capabilities: Marks files with status icons, accent bars or text badges
Sets or clears a status property on one or several files
Groups files by status and by series in the file explorer
Replaces file names with day, category and title labels
Sorts files by date, category and title
disambiguation: Not a task or project manager; it only displays and sorts frontmatter values in the file explorer.
extras: Sorting and labels hook internal Obsidian APIs and fail safe to default order and file names if those change; labels appear only in the file explorer, not in tabs, search, quick switcher or links. Colors and icons can be overridden with a CSS snippet.
problem: Status, dates and categories kept in frontmatter are invisible in the file explorer, which lists files only by name.
summary: File explorer add-on that shows frontmatter status, title, date, category and series on file rows and sorts files by those values.
